svg.title: No sufficiency or CP attainability is claimed for a support pattern satisfying this inequality. At least three of the six branch input/output support matrices are faithful. The argument is independent of any cyclic covariance. Put Sσ = ∑︁ ij rank σij and SF = ∑︁ ij rank Fij. If i ∈A, the first-symbol state ρi is faithful; its output under Ψj has support exactly Qj. Thus σij has rank three whenever i, j ∈A. Similarly Fij has rank three whenever i, j ∈B, since a faithful Ej satisfies Ψ∗ i (Ej) ≥cEi. Therefore
